author: Kushal
problem: heights lists the heights of holiday cabins on a hillside, starting with the cabin nearest the sea. A cabin has a sea view if it is taller than every cabin in front of it (closer to the sea). Return the positions of the cabins with a sea view.
bug_description: Uses h >= tallest instead of h > tallest, so a cabin exactly as tall as the tallest one in front of it is wrongly given a view.

comments.accurate: Returns positions of cabins taller than every cabin closer to the sea
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns positions of cabins at least as tall as every cabin closer to the sea
comments.wrong_location: Height comparison verified; tallest may need to start at 0 rather than None
